summary.name: Kimi API Platform
summary.one_liner: Developer platform for accessing the Kimi K3 large language model through an API, with built-in tools such as web search, code execution and file analysis.
keywords: pay as you go ai api
use_cases: Building autonomous coding agents for debugging and refactoring
Adding web search with cited sources to an AI app
Analyzing Excel or CSV files with an LLM
Classifying customer conversations and extracting key information
summary.what_it_does: The page presents Kimi API Platform as a developer offering for the Kimi K3 model, which it describes as having a 1M-token context window and Tool Calling. It lists a set of built-in tools: web search with source citation, memory storage for conversation history and user preferences, Excel/CSV analysis, Python execution, sandboxed JavaScript execution via QuickJS, date/time handling, URL-to-markdown extraction, unit and currency conversion, and encoding/decoding. It also describes use-case pages for coding agents, research assistants, legal and patent document work, and conversation analysis. Customer testimonials name integrations by FunPlus, Tencent CodeBuddy, XtalPi, AlphaEngine and Verdent. Pricing is described as pay-as-you-go for individuals and small teams, and as enterprise plans with SLAs and dedicated support.
notable: Kimi K3 model with 1M-token context window and tool calling
Built-in tool suite including web search, Python and QuickJS execution, and Excel/CSV analysis
Pay-as-you-go billing with usage-based tiered rate limits
Enterprise tier with SLA, data compliance and dedicated support
caveats: Usage-based pricing; exact per-token rates are not stated on the page
Enterprise features such as SLA and dedicated support are described without specific terms
